name: com.neoxider.coreaimcp
description: Optional Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that runs INSIDE a live CoreAI game session (play mode or a build) so an external agent - Claude Code and any other MCP client - can drive the running game over a standard protocol. Exposes the in-game Command Bar surface (execute_lua, manage_mods, get_mod_logs, screenshot, and world_command when present) as MCP tools over localhost streamable HTTP. Off by default: drop a CoreAiMcpServer component into a scene (or call CoreAiMcpServer.StartServer). Loopback-only and opt-in, with Origin/Host validation and bearer-token auth (the token is printed to the console at start) - never expose beyond loopback. Depends on com.neoxider.coreaimods; the world tool registers only when that service exists in the current composition.
